title: Family Friendly Smithsonian Natural History Museum Private Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: It is imperative that you provide us with guests MOBILE PHONE NUMBER (including country code)

Notes: Natural History Museum and other attractions or museums in DC may be subjected to occasional closures without previous warning from the museum management. When this occurs, we will provide guests with an appropriate alternative if the museum opening time is delayed more than 1h from the tour starting time. In these cases we are unable to provide refunds or discounts. Appropriate dress is required for entry into some sites on this tour. No large bags or suitcases are allowed inside the museum, only handbags or small thin bag packs are allowed through security. Due to increased security measures at many attractions some lines may form on tours with 'Skip the Line' or 'No Wait' access. Some specific rooms inside the museum are subjected to a very quiet or restricted right to speak inside, in this cases your guide will provide the information about this places before entering the specific rooms where this rule applies. Some collections may vary along the year.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Wonders at the National Museum of Natural History – Perfect for Families!

Join a fun and engaging 2-hour guided tour of the National Museum of Natural History, where kids and parents alike will marvel at dazzling gems, fascinating mummies, and incredible animals. Explore rare treasures from around the world that have amazed visitors for over a century. A perfect adventure for the whole family!
